label: Current instance
description: Say which instance this run is for. A run started for an instance (through its own trigger copy, its instance token, or the `Weft-Instance` header on a gated route) fires `instance` with its id; a run for no instance (a cron, a manager route) fires `nobody` instead. Exactly one of the two fires, so each is a branch.

outputs.name: instance
outputs.description: The instance's id, the one your program gives it (`user-42`). Fires only when the run is for an instance.

outputs.name: nobody
outputs.description: True, and fires only when the run is for no instance.
